overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Innovation Leaders ETF (TNXT) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on total market equity. TNXT is actively managed, targeting companies considered leaders of innovation primarily in developed markets, but may reach into emerging markets as well TNXT was launched on Jan 28, 2026 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
